title: Kabse Citrus Bites
description: A diabetic-friendly version of a citrusy, crispy British dish featuring kabse spice and bhuna, ideal for sick-day comfort food.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour and melted butter. Mix well.
Add honey syrup, saffron threads, orange zest, lemon juice, and beaten egg white. Stir until the mixture forms a dough.
Divide the dough into 12 equal portions. Roll each portion into balls and flatten slightly with your hands or a rolling pin.
Sprinkle kabse spice mix over the top of each ball.
Bake for about 10 minutes, or until golden brown on both sides. Flip halfway through baking time to ensure even cooking.
Remove from oven and let cool before serving.
